import html # Example HTML template containing a placeholder for user content. html_template = """ Visitor Message

Welcome!

{user_content}

""" def render_html_page(visitor_message: str) -> str: """ Render an HTML page by safely embedding the visitor's message into a predefined template. Args: visitor_message: The raw user-provided string to be inserted into the HTML. Returns: A complete HTML string with the user's content safely escaped. """ # Escape any special HTML characters to prevent injection (CWE-74). safe_content = html.escape(visitor_message, quote=True) # Insert the escaped content into the template. return html_template.format(user_content=safe_content)
